## Original definition (verbatim)

2. **FOS-000002 — Make utility parse failure affect the command result.** **S per tool; no dependencies; §2–§3.** Start with [list:266](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/cli/fossilize_list.cpp#L266), then [rehash:226](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/cli/fossilize_rehash.cpp#L226) and [prune:1003](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/cli/fossilize_prune.cpp#L1003), one small change each. Each logs a failed parse and proceeds toward success (E8). Retain partial output if useful, but return nonzero and identify incomplete scope; never print an ordinary empty connectivity row as a verified empty dependency set. **Check:** version rejection and invalid JSON; valid empty databases still succeed. Later apply the same rule to opt/disasm. Keep fallback optimization policy explicit rather than making an error-level message alone decide failure.

   **Required automated success criteria — pending implementation:**

   - **CLI subprocess regression tests, per migrated tool:** E8 version rejection and invalid JSON return nonzero and identify incomplete scope; valid populated and valid empty inputs return zero. List connectivity does not emit a rejected item as an ordinary verified empty dependency row.
   - **Partial-output and policy tests:** A valid item followed by an invalid item preserves any promised partial output but never returns success. An explicitly permitted optimizer fallback returns the declared outcome and remains distinguishable from an unhandled parse failure when that tool is migrated.

implementation.change: In cli/fossilize_list.cpp parse_tag, immediately return false on parser failure with tag/hash and explicit connectivity-incomplete diagnostic. Existing caller propagation aborts before any stdout rows. Do not broaden plain list/--size into parsing.

In cli/fossilize_rehash.cpp return EXIT_FAILURE immediately on parse false, with tag/hash and explicit incomplete output/prefix diagnostic. Preserve existing recorder destruction/teardown so previously queued valid prefix is emitted. No continued traversal after rejected mutable callbacks.

In cli/fossilize_prune.cpp return EXIT_FAILURE immediately on parse false, before applicationInfo raw copy and before access_pipelines/copy_accessed_types. Diagnostic identifies tag/hash and output scope incomplete. Previously copied accepted applicationInfo prefix may remain; no pipeline prefix or closure promise after failure.

Add test/utility_parse_test.cpp GPU-free fixture/verification helper using existing public recorder/database APIs and explicit failure checks (not assert), plus test/utility_parse.cmake subprocess driver. Register utility-parse-<tool>-<case> cases in test/CMakeLists.txt under FOSSILIZE_CLI using target-file generator expressions, isolated per-case work directories, per-child timeout <=30s and CTest timeout <=90s. CMake subprocess facilities avoid new native process implementations and dependencies.

Create valid outer FOZ fixtures via DatabaseInterface. Valid populated fixture has dependency-complete app/shader/layout/compute entries, valid empty archive is actually prepared, bad fixtures use syntactic malformed JSON or version 999 without assertion-crashing structural JSON. Mixed fixtures use increasing hashes to guarantee valid item precedes failure. Verify real emitted records and decoded semantics, not merely nonempty file size. Candidate helper/runner must support baseline utility-path override for negative controls.

Document intentional false-success exit change, exact fail-fast/partial-output policies, ordinary list enumeration behavior, new CTest coverage, four applicable Linux configurations, portable registration and actual Windows evidence limitation in local-docs/verification.md or suitable CLI documentation. Do not relabel desired standard as verified whole-project behavior.

non_goals: No opt/disasm migration or optimizer fallback policy change; preserve explicit future obligation.

No structured-result API/mode, stable diagnostic schema, parser schema hardening, transactional rollback, aggregate outcome API, persistence finalization redesign, worker/IPC/process implementation changes, GPU/Steam/cache-warming claim.
No extra issues/sub-issues or split bookkeeping; keep root issue open until user merge and leave epic #8 open.

risks_and_limits: StateReplayer callbacks can run before eventual parser false. Fail-fast avoids continuing with uncertain state; it does not promise transactional rollback of a rejected multi-object blob in recorder output.
Prune previously copied invalid applicationInfo after parser false; explicit early-return test is required.
Rehash recorder is asynchronous: partial-output assertion must reopen output only after process exit/teardown.

Windows native runtime unavailable on this Linux host. Register tests portably and report exact limitation. If checker/coordinator interprets parent applicability as requiring native Windows for this portable-only slice, route that unmet prerequisite as environment finding/decision rather than silently skip a required gate.
Changed source paths require role-isolated builds. Do not reuse a different candidate/source build as independent evidence.
All gates retain the original four-hour run deadline and 600-second per-command maximum; inability to finish required checks is incomplete work, not acceptance.

boundaries: Existing CLI syntax and valid/empty successful outcomes are preserved. Intentional behavior change: any parse false in these migrated paths returns EXIT_FAILURE; no log-severity based outcome policy.

Public C++ signatures, database schema and binary/protocol interfaces are untouched; no new source/binary ABI or stable prose contract is claimed. Existing CLI compatibility is checked by real subprocess invocations.
List raw hash/size listing remains enumeration, not JSON validation. Only connectivity currently invokes the parser.
scope.outcome: Make parser false directly affect utility outcome, identify affected resource and incomplete processing, and define bounded safe partial-output behavior. One coherent unsplit work unit covers all present migrated tools.
scope.platform_applicability: Production changes are portable CLI return/control flow, not Linux/Windows worker/process implementations. Register portable CMake execute_process regression cases on every CLI-enabled platform. Linux native runtime matrix is mandatory here; native Windows execution is unavailable and must be disclosed as unverified, never inferred from Linux. Do not claim the parent epic or platform-wide conformance complete.
scope.problem: list --connectivity, rehash and prune log StateReplayer::parse failure but continue to success; list fabricates ordinary empty dependency rows and prune can copy rejected application metadata.
scope.scope_interpretation: Original text explicitly says Later apply to opt/disasm and optimizer fallback when that tool is migrated. This run migrates list/rehash/prune; conditional future fallback acceptance remains verbatim in original and is not represented as currently implemented/verified.
